title: Seagrove "Off The Clock" 181 Eastern Lake Road
h1: Seagrove "Off The Clock" 181 Eastern Lake Road
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the beach- Parking lot is available at Eastern Lake Beach Access- Stunning Gulf views- Private pool & sitting spa *Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $55 per day*- Professionally decorated - Pool table- Elevator- Rooftop deck- Outdoor kitchen- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Carriage house- 9 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Set in gorgeous Seagrove Beach and sleeping up to 38 guests, Off The Clock boasts 9 bedrooms and 8 bathrooms. Natural beauty, family-friendly fun, and quintessential beach town charm await in this eastern 30A town. With a private pool and sitting spa—plus proximity to the beach—guests are sure to fall in love.Inside and outside entertainment mix in this delightful beach haven. On the first floor, a relaxed living space with a pool table and 55” TV connects to the private backyard. The covered outdoor kitchen with a dining table for 8 begs for an afternoon of barbecue, while the zero-entry swimming pool and sitting spa tempt guests to bask in the sun. Sleeping accommodations include 2 bunk rooms with 2 queen-over-queen beds and 1 full-over-full.White shiplap walls and a wood ceiling create a coastal cottage feel in the open great room on the second floor. Elegant, naval blue couches and 2 plush accent chairs continue the theme, providing guests a comfortable gathering spot. The kitchen hosts premium appliances and a marble-top island that seats 7. A contemporary dining table made of pale wood offers room for 8. The adjacent porch has a mini living area, TV, and dining table. The 2 guest bedrooms with king beds have access to a second porch with pool views.On the third floor, the elevator opens onto a charming sitting area with a TV. Down the hall, discover the primary bedroom with a king bed, Gulf views, and access to a shaded porch with a spiral staircase to the fourth-floor lookout tower. There are 2 guest bedrooms with king beds and a bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin beds.The attached Carriage House has a kitchenette, cozy living area with a sleeper sofa, and bedroom with a king bed.Off the Clock’s luxurious finishes and private outdoor space make for the perfect Seagrove Beach getaway. Parking for 6 vehicles, 9 complimentary bikes, and a 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle make exploration easy. The closest beach access is a 7-minute walk between 471 and 493 Eastern Lake Road. Book this beach home for an unforgettable vacation today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFIRST FLOOR- Bunk Bedroom: Two Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed and Full-over-Full Bunk Beds, Semi-Private Bathroom with Two Showers- Bunk Bedroom: Two Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed and Full-over-Full Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Two ShowersSECOND FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Bunk Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyCARRIAGE HOUSE- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/ Tub Combo- Living Area: Queen Sleeper SofaPlease note: There is no parking allowed on the condo easement walkway along the side of the house.

Off the Clock’s luxurious finishes and private outdoor space make for the perfect Seagrove Beach getaway.
